annotations.title: Start a DAO LLC wallet proof

description: Returns a one-time message, valid for 10 minutes, that names a DAO LLC entity this account owns and an EVM wallet address. Signing it with personal_sign in that wallet states that the wallet controls the LLC. It is not a transfer and not title, and Scopeweb never asks for a seed or private key. For when the user wants to show that their wallet controls their DAO LLC. Cannot spend money.

address.description: The 0x address of the controlling wallet.

chain.description: CAIP-2, eip155:<chain id>. Defaults to eip155:1.

name: start_wallet_proof
